findings.title: apply_discount returns price*percent float instead of percent-off Decimal
findings.explanation: Diff replaces Decimal percent-off logic with float(price)*float(percent). E.g. price 100 percent 10 returns 1000.0 instead of Decimal 90.00. Drops 0-100 validation, to_money/quantize, and return-type contract relied on by Cart.total and Invoice.total.

evidence.why: New body does float(price)*float(percent) returning price times percent as float.
Docstring requires percent-off Decimal rounded to cents, e.g. 10 means 10% off.

findings.suggestion: Restore Decimal logic: amount=to_money(price); pct=Decimal(str(percent)); validate 0<=pct<=100; return quantize(amount*(1-pct/100)).
findings.verifier_note: Verified against file: body is amount*rate float, breaks documented Decimal percent-off contract introduced by this diff.
